info.description:
North Bound Interface (NBI) REST API exposed by voltha-go-controller (VGC).
It provides configuration and operational endpoints for subscribers, bandwidth
profiles, IGMP proxy, multicast, flows, devices, ports, meters, groups, DHCP
allocations, MAC learning and the OLT flow service.
info.title: VOLTHA Go Controller NBI REST API
